# Börslunch i Malmö: Fastigheter och kontinentala aktiecase

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-09-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Börslunch was recorded in Malmö. The host was Wihlborgs CEO Ulrika Hallengren and the guest was Milton Löfgren of IKC. Hallengren argued that the property sector recovery is gradually improving and defended Wihlborgs' large debt-financed acquisition from Castellum. Löfgren is bullish on equities overall and favours European banks such as UniCredit and BNP Paribas plus electrification-exposed industrials, while staying underweight property, though he thinks property valuations are close to a bottom. The news segment covered Sampo falling on Solidium's stake sale, Sweco rising on a Handelsbanken buy call, and a cited analyst defending Novo Nordisk after its capital markets day.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 UCG — UniCredit | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest's IKC holds it as a top Europe-fund position. Sees it as a winner from normalised rates with room left after the rally.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion (Milton Löfgren, IKC). European banks benefit from normalised rates, cost cuts give high ROE, and P/E of 10-12 on 2027 is still cheap. Credit cycle is strong and heavy dividends and buybacks return capital. IKC has owned the banks for a long time and keeps liking them.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the credit cycle turns and loan losses rise
- if interest rates fall back sharply
- if capital returns are cut

> *"Vi tycker att det fortfarande ser väldigt billigt ut i P 10, 12 på 2027 för många av de här bankerna."*

---

### 🟢 BNP — BNP Paribas | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Large IKC Europe-fund holding. Guest says European banks remain cheap and are winners from normalised rates.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Same thesis as UniCredit: margin recovery from low levels, cost efficiency, strong economy and credit cycle, and extensive dividends and buybacks. Valuation still undemanding despite the multi-year rally.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit losses rise
- if rates fall sharply
- if valuation re-rates beyond P/E 12

> *"Ja, vi har ägt framför allt europeiska banker över en längre period och fortsätter att gilla det."*

---

### ⛔ NDA-SE — Nordea | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

IKC avoids Scandinavian big banks despite low valuation. Skeptical of the deposit/savings model and credit losses.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. They admit the banks are very cheap but prefer continental banks because of a different business model around deposit rates and concern about credit losses. The guest says it doesn't weigh heavily today, so conviction is low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit-loss concerns ease
- if the deposit-margin model proves resilient

> *"Ja, de är väldigt billiga, men jag tror vi. Det är väl lite annan affärsmodell"*

---

### ⛔ SWED-A — Swedbank | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Grouped with the Scandinavian big banks that IKC avoids over business-model and credit-loss skepticism.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Cheap, but skeptical of the savings-account deposit model and credit-loss risk. Low conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit-loss concerns ease

> *"så det är lite annan affärsmodell som vi är lite mer skeptiska kring, framförallt kring kreditförluster"*

---

### ⛔ DNB — DNB | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Grouped with the Scandinavian big banks that IKC avoids over business-model and credit-loss skepticism.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Same reasoning as Nordea and Swedbank: cheap, but IKC is skeptical of the model and credit losses. Low conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if credit-loss concerns ease

> *"så det är lite annan affärsmodell som vi är lite mer skeptiska kring, framförallt kring kreditförluster"*

---

### 🟢 SWEC-B — Sweco | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Handelsbanken sees a buying opportunity for the first time in four years, and the stock rises.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (Handelsbanken), not the host or guest. First buy call in four years suggests the valuation or outlook has turned attractive. No further detail given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the consultancy order intake weakens
- if Handelsbanken reverses its view

> *"Sweco de stiger efter att Handelsbanken ser köpläge i bolaget, första gången på fyra år."*

---

### 🟠 WIHL — Wihlborgs | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

CEO sees brighter rental and transaction markets and synergies from the Castellum deal. Guest says the property sector looks cheap and near a bottom.

#### Reasoning

This is the CEO's own view plus a guest who is underweight property but concedes valuations have probably bottomed. Positives: 20-year 10%/yr growth, Öresund growth, a Novo 15-year lease, and vacancies in the acquired portfolio to fill. Risks: higher leverage from the bridge-loan-financed deal, a possible share issue (CEO says not timely), and rising long rates.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a new share issue at a discount is announced
- if loan-to-value is not reduced within the 18-month bridge period
- if vacancies in the acquired portfolio persist
- if rates keep rising

> *"Så visst är situationen ljusare nu än i början av sommaren."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

SB1 analyst says the post-capital-markets-day selloff is hard to understand and the 2030 targets (5% growth) are modest. The guest's fund sold out, citing losses to Lilly.

#### Reasoning

Views conflict. Cited analyst Önnerus (SB1) implies the market is too pessimistic because the targets are conservative and the Wegovy pill launch is going well. The guest (IKC) exited, saying Novo is losing the obesity battle to Eli Lilly. Net: watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Wegovy pill uptake disappoints
- if Novo keeps losing share to Lilly
- if the 2030 targets are cut

> *"Reaktionen är lite svår att förstå."*

---

### 🟡 AZN — AstraZeneca | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

IKC holds it as a defensive position it still likes. Small weight.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Kept as defensive exposure, and the guest still likes it, but it is a very small part of the portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defensive positioning is no longer needed

> *"Men vi har lite defensiva positioner i Astra, som vi fortfarande gillar och Novartis"*

---

### 🟡 NOVN — Novartis | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Defensive holding in IKC's Europe fund that it still likes. Small weight.

#### Reasoning

Guest opinion. Defensive healthcare exposure kept at a small weight.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defensive positioning is no longer needed

> *"Men vi har lite defensiva positioner i Astra, som vi fortfarande gillar och Novartis, vår Europafond."*
